* feat(effect): the wheel turns each segment at a pace set by where it sits (brandon-menus-sjhy.ju8)

The wheel lives in rich-js, and 0.27.0 reads a segment's place from the
frame it is handed, so moving to it is the feature and the row wrapping
here does not change.

0.27.0's Palette is built from a total set of roles, so paletteRole's
undefined branch cannot run. paletteRole, DecorRole and ThemePole go, and
so do the two tests of a palette that can no longer be built.
